extracted.intended_audience: medical journal editors, authors, peer reviewers, and publishers
extracted.subtask_description: The ICMJE Recommendations set standards and requirements for the conduct, reporting, editing, and publication of scholarly work in medical journals, covering authorship, conflicts of interest, peer review, trial registration, manuscript preparation, corrections/retractions, and related editorial policies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Purpose of the Recommendations
rubrics_metrics.description: The stated purpose of the ICMJE Recommendations for conduct, reporting, editing, and publication of scholarly work in medical journals.

rubrics_metrics.name: Who Should Use the Recommendations?
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on the intended users of the Recommendations (e.g., authors, editors, peer reviewers, publishers).

rubrics_metrics.name: History of the Recommendations
rubrics_metrics.description: Background and evolution of the ICMJE Recommendations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Roles & Responsibilities
rubrics_metrics.description: General delineation of roles and responsibilities in the publication process (editors, reviewers, authors, publishers).

rubrics_metrics.name: Defining the Role of Authors and Contributors
rubrics_metrics.description: Criteria and guidance for who qualifies as an author versus a contributor and what responsibilities each role entails.

rubrics_metrics.name: Author Responsibilities—Conflicts of Interest
rubrics_metrics.description: Author obligations regarding disclosure and management of conflicts of interest.

rubrics_metrics.name: Responsibilities in the Submission and Peer-Review Process
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards for how submissions should be handled and what is expected of authors, reviewers, and editors during peer review.

rubrics_metrics.name: Journal Owners and Editorial Freedom
rubrics_metrics.description: Principles protecting editorial independence and guidance on relationships between journal owners and editorial staff.

rubrics_metrics.name: Protection of Research Participants
rubrics_metrics.description: Ethical and procedural requirements to protect human and animal research participants in reported studies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Publishing & Editorial Issues
rubrics_metrics.description: Broad editorial and publishing policy issues that journals should address in their operations and policies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Corrections, Retractions, Republications and Version Control
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards and recommended processes for issuing corrections, retractions, republications, and maintaining version control of published materials.

rubrics_metrics.name: Scientific Misconduct, Expressions of Concern, and Retraction
rubrics_metrics.description: Criteria and procedures for identifying, investigating, and responding to scientific misconduct including expressions of concern and retraction policies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Copyright
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on copyright ownership, transfer, and licensing issues for scholarly publications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Overlapping Publications
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards and expectations about duplicate, redundant, or overlapping publication and how to handle such cases.

rubrics_metrics.name: Correspondence
rubrics_metrics.description: Policies governing letters, correspondence, and responses in the journal context.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fees
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance regarding fees associated with publication (e.g., page charges, open access fees) and transparency about them.

rubrics_metrics.name: Supplements, Theme Issues, and Special Series
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards for organizing and disclosing supplements, themed issues, and special series (including potential conflicts or sponsorship).

rubrics_metrics.name: Sponsorship or Partnership
rubrics_metrics.description: Policies about sponsorship, partnerships, and how such relationships must be disclosed and managed by journals and authors.

rubrics_metrics.name: Electronic Publishing
rubrics_metrics.description: Recommendations specific to electronic publishing practices, including online presentation, archiving, and related considerations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Advertising
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on advertising in medical journals and measures to separate advertising from editorial content.

rubrics_metrics.name: Journals and the Media
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on interacting with the media, press releases, and communicating research findings to the public.

rubrics_metrics.name: Clinical Trials
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards related to clinical trials reporting, registration, and transparency requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Manuscript Preparation
rubrics_metrics.description: Recommendations for preparing manuscripts for submission (formatting, reporting standards, required sections).

rubrics_metrics.name: Preparing for Submission
rubrics_metrics.description: Practical guidance authors should follow before submitting a manuscript (checklists, required statements, documentation).

rubrics_metrics.name: Sending the Submission
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedural guidance on how submissions should be sent to journals and what accompanying materials are required.

rubrics_metrics.name: Translations
rubrics_metrics.description: Policies and guidance related to translated versions of articles and handling multi-language content.

rubrics_metrics.name: Archives
rubrics_metrics.description: Recommendations on archiving published content and ensuring long-term access and preservation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Conflicts of Interest (general)
rubrics_metrics.description: Overall policies on disclosure and management of conflicts of interest for authors, reviewers, and editors (separate from author-specific obligations noted above).

rubrics_metrics.name: Stating That They Follow the ICMJE Recommendations (for Journals)
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance for journals on how to state they follow ICMJE Recommendations and implications of doing so.

rubrics_metrics.name: Journal Listing Request Form
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedural item allowing journals to request listing as following ICMJE Recommendations (meta-guidance for journals).

rubrics_metrics.name: Clinical Trials Registration
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirement and guidance about prospective registration of clinical trials in public registries as a condition for publication.

rubrics_metrics.name: Conflict of Interest Disclosure Forms
rubrics_metrics.description: Standardized forms and expectations for disclosing conflicts of interest (e.g., ICMJE disclosure form).

rubrics_metrics.name: Miscellaneous (news & editorials)
rubrics_metrics.description: Catch-all category for additional items including news, editorials, FAQs, and related resources accompanying the Recommendations.
